sentences.text:
Shri Rajesh Kumar Sen - Advocate for the applicants.
 Shri Pradeep Gupta - Government Advocate for the respondent/
 Order

This second bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.25/2021 dated 19.02.2021 registered at Police Station Kindrai,
Seoni, District Seoni (M.P.). for the offence punishable under Sections 409, 420, 120-B, 34 of IPC.

Applicants are in detention since 30.09.2022.
2.

Applicants' first application was dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed with liberty to renew the prayer for grant of bail after six months vide order dated 04.03.2024 passed in M.Cr.C.
No.6170/2024.
3 .

As per the prosecution case, 5 years ago, ASPNJ producer company established its branch and gave a lucrative offer to the complainant and others that who so ever will deposit money in their scheme, he will get double money after maturity period of 5 years.
It is further alleged that applicants and others through the Manager Dilip Thakur deposited more than Rs. 2,50,000/- in that company but before maturity of the period of the NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2024 :MPHC-JBP:45922 2 MCRC-37468-2024 deposit
, Manager Dilip Thakur and others closed the office and fled away by usurping the money of the poor persons.
FIR was registered.
4. Learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that applicants have not committed any offence.
They are innocent.
They have been falsely implicated.
It is further contended that entire embezzled amount has already been deposited before the Trial Court by main accused Dilip Thakur.

sentences.text: Co-accused Dilip Thakur has already been released on bail.
On the aforesaid pretext, it is prayed that applicants may be released on bail pending the trial.

5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the respondent/State has submitted that total allegations of cheating and embezzlement of money against the present applicants and main accused Dilip Thakur are of Rs.6,78,000/- and same has already been deposited by the main accused before the Trial Court.

6.Considering the detention period of applicants and the fact that final conclusion of the trial will take considerable time but without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I am of the view that it is a case in which further pre-trial detention of the applicants is not warranted.
Consequently, this second bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicants, stands allowed.

7. It is directed that applicants - Rajkumar Banerjee, Dalidas Gupta and Mausmi Banerjee be released on bail on their furnishing a personal NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:45922 3 MCRC-37468-2024 bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh only) each with two solvent sureties each of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for their regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that they shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

They shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437 (3) Cr.P.C.
8.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
